Name: Geba
Description: A Benjaminite city, identified with Jaba' in the West Bank, where Jonathan struck down the Philistine garrison, sparking open war with the Philistines. It was later given to the Levites as one of their cities, and under Josiah it marked the northern end of his reform, 'from Geba to Beer-sheba,' when he defiled the high places.
BiblicalSignificance: Geba shows how one bold act of faith can change the course of a war, and how a place of battle later became a place set apart for the Levites' service.
